required_manual_checks.description: Investigate the exact committed 2A.2d candidate tree and preserve it. Reconcile the controlled diagnostic summary (682 passed, 17 failed, 78 skipped, 777 total; 11 failed suites) with the complete failure output; identify every failing suite and assertion. Do not infer root causes from the summary alone. Record redacted evidence and commands in apps/os/docs/DB-PROOF-001.md.

For production-2e-consumer-parity, production-2e-raw-parity, and production-2e-source-flip, compare exactly the vault and production state expected by each test, identify the first concrete field or object divergence for each failure, and establish with evidence whether production legitimately advanced beyond the frozen vault, the expectation is stale, or a runtime or harness defect exists. Do not assume either source is correct or overwrite either source for parity.

For production-app-login, identify the exact RESIDUE assertion and row or event count that differed, when it ran relative to final cleanup, and why the later cleanup verifier reported zero applogin organizations, users, memberships, prospects, and scratch schemas.

For request-isolation, identify the exact concurrency/barrier and crossover assertions that failed, inspect connection, pooling, and session assumptions, and prove whether each failure is environmental, timing-related, or a real request-scope or authorization regression. Do not weaken concurrency assertions to obtain a pass.

Classify every failure as legitimate production/vault data drift, stale test expectation, harness/environment defect, runtime regression, authorization/session regression, cleanup/residue assertion defect, or another clearly evidenced category. State whether any application regression or obsolete expectation is proven, whether 2A.2d can remain untouched, and the smallest separate fix task(s) by concern with exact allowed write paths. State which fresh proof receipts each eventual fix requires. Mark unresolved causes as unproven rather than guessing.

Write only apps/os/docs/DB-PROOF-001.md. Do not fix code or tests, change Sales or 2A.2d, deploy, or print database URLs, passwords, credentials, or owner secrets. Prefer read-only production inspection and run only the smallest focused tests necessary; any production mutation must be within an already-sanctioned diagnostic mechanism with verified cleanup. Do not rerun the entire production DB gate blindly.
